dedupe_keys.name: roads and highways in puerto rico

description: Roads and Highways in Puerto Rico is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by  (deposited on HydroShare). This shape file contains the primary and secondary roads for transportation infrastructure within the Territory of Puerto Rico. The file was obtained from the US Census Bureau TIGER/Line using the 2017 released version. Although there are many more roadways possible, this file contains 4233 line geometries representing primary and secondary roads and thoroughfares. Coverage: Puerto Rico, United States. The resource was created 2019-03-04 and last updated 2026-02-14; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the resource metadata. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
